comparison.causal_boundary: Only choosing one output coordinate cannot change gVp at the identical physical model. Here true Vs replaces the old blurred Vs in the evaluation model, changing wavefields and residuals; rho was already constant and equal in both cases.
comparison.raw_sensitivity_statistics: Fractions of squared Euclidean input-grid gradient norm, not physical wave energy or resolution/reconstruction scores.
comparison.result: Fixing true Vs did not increase this case's relative deep Vp sensitivity. The controlled ablation is retained without an improvement claim.
comparison.main_color_scale: One shared linear P99 from concatenated old/new absolute gVp at depth>=1km; every original solid-grid sample drawn; display saturation fractions manifested.
